statements.status_notes: Upstream GHSA-xcq7-p3pf-p88h (https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-python/security/advisories/GHSA-xcq7-p3pf-p88h): TraceState.from_header in opentelemetry-api parses the W3C tracestate header with an unbounded regular expression, costing quadratic CPU on a crafted header. Fixed in opentelemetry-api 1.45.1 (https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-python/pull/5749). Listed the files of every published airflow build, 3.3.0-0 to 3.4.0-7 (48 builds, amd64 and arm64), and read the opentelemetry-api version from its dist-info directory under /usr/lib/airflow/lib/python3.13/site-packages; both architectures agree for every build. Builds 3.3.0-0 to 3.3.0-3 ship opentelemetry-api 1.43.0 and 3.3.1-0 to 3.3.2-7 ship 1.44.0. Builds 3.3.2-8 to 3.3.2-19 ship 1.45.1, and 3.4.0-0 to the current 3.4.0-7 ship 1.45.2. The first build with the fix is 3.3.2-8.

The first build with the fix is 3.3.2-8.
